body:
SKELETAL SKIRMISHER
CR 4

XP 1,200
CE Medium undead
Init +3, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +4 armor, +1 natural)
hp 48 (9d8 +8)
Fort +3, Ref +8, Will +6; DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune cold, undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee scimitar +9/+4 (1d6 +2/18-20) plus siphon Life

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 17, Con -, Int 2, Wis 10, Cha 13
Base Atk +6; CMB +9, CMD 21

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Thousand Cuts (Su)

When a skeletal skirmisher hits a target with a melee attack, it may use its attack of opportunity to immediately make another attack action against that target with a -2 penalty to its attack roll. If that attack hits, the skeletal skirmisher regains its attack of opportunity.

This ability may be us ed to strike multiple times, so long as it hits, but doing so stacks the -2 penalty until it either misses or the skeletal skirmisher chooses to stop.

Siphon Life (Su)

When a target is struck by a skeletal skirmisher, the target suffers 1d4 negative energy damage and the skeletal skirmisher member is heal ed for the same a mount.
